title: Marketing Your Pet Grooming Business: 5 Practical Tips - Paragon School of Pet Grooming

facts.fact: The article titled 'Marketing Your Pet Grooming Business' presents five practical marketing tips for grooming businesses.
facts.quote: Marketing Your Pet Grooming Business: 5 Practical Tips

facts.fact: The post is a guest article written by Gingr, a software vendor, and is published on the Paragon School of Pet Grooming blog.

The article recommends that grooming businesses collect, store, and analyze customer data points including age, location, profession, communication preferences, pets (number, type, and age), hobbies, engagement history, income, and education.
